meta.disclaimer: Rounded, approximate values for personal footprint estimates. Not audit-grade. Check the sources and replace values with your own data before using the numbers for reporting.

confidence_levels.derived: Calculated from a typical published fuel or grid factor plus a stated assumption (for example fuel economy).
confidence_levels.approximate: Rounded typical value in line with published ranges, not tied to one exact table.
confidence_levels.assumption: Rough estimate built on a stated portion size or usage assumption. Treat as low confidence.

car_petrol.label: Petrol car
car_petrol.source: Typical published fuel factor (petrol is about 2.31 kg CO2 per litre)
car_petrol.note: 2.31 kg CO2/L divided by an assumed 14 km/L. Tailpipe emissions only, per vehicle-km.

car_diesel.label: Diesel car
car_diesel.source: Typical published fuel factor (diesel is about 2.68 kg CO2 per litre)
car_diesel.note: 2.68 kg CO2/L divided by an assumed 17 km/L. Tailpipe emissions only, per vehicle-km.

car_ev.label: Electric car
car_ev.source: Assumed 15 kWh per 100 km, multiplied by the regional grid intensity
car_ev.note: Changes with the grid: the same trip emits less in a cleaner-grid region.

two_wheeler_petrol.label: Motorbike or scooter (petrol)
two_wheeler_petrol.source: Typical published fuel factor (petrol about 2.31 kg CO2 per litre)
two_wheeler_petrol.note: 2.31 kg CO2/L divided by an assumed 45 km/L. Per vehicle-km, one rider.

auto_rickshaw.label: Auto-rickshaw (CNG)
auto_rickshaw.source: Assumed CNG auto at about 25 km per kg CNG (about 2.75 kg CO2 per kg)
auto_rickshaw.note: About 0.11 kg per vehicle-km shared between roughly 2 passengers, per passenger-km.

bus.label: City bus
bus.source: Published city-bus values commonly sit around 0.1 kg CO2e per passenger-km
bus.note: Per passenger-km. Depends heavily on how full the bus is.

train.label: Train (electric)
train.source: Assumed 0.04 kWh per passenger-km, multiplied by the regional grid intensity
train.note: Per passenger-km. Assumes an electrified line.

metro.label: Metro
metro.source: Assumed 0.07 kWh per passenger-km, multiplied by the regional grid intensity

flight.label: Flight (economy)
flight.source: Published short-haul economy values are roughly 0.15 to 0.25 kg CO2e per passenger-km
flight.note: Per passenger-km, no radiative forcing uplift. Short flights emit more per km than long ones.

electricity_home.label: Home electricity
electricity_home.note: This is the main localised factor: the same kWh has a different footprint in each region.

lpg_cooking.label: LPG for cooking
lpg_cooking.source: Combustion of LPG is roughly 3 kg CO2e per kg
lpg_cooking.note: Combustion only. A 14.2 kg cylinder is about 43 kg CO2e.

meal_vegan.label: Vegan meal
meal_vegan.source: Poore & Nemecek (2018) per-kg values via Our World in Data, times assumed portion sizes
meal_vegan.note: Typical plant-based meal with grains, pulses and vegetables.

meal_vegetarian.label: Vegetarian meal
meal_vegetarian.source: Poore & Nemecek (2018) per-kg values via Our World in Data, times assumed portion sizes
meal_vegetarian.note: Typical meal with grains, pulses, vegetables and some dairy.

meal_egg.label: Egg-based meal
meal_egg.source: Poore & Nemecek (2018) per-kg values via Our World in Data, times assumed portion sizes

meal_fish.label: Fish meal
meal_fish.source: Poore & Nemecek (2018) per-kg values via Our World in Data, times assumed portion sizes
meal_fish.note: Wide range between wild-caught and farmed fish.

meal_chicken.label: Chicken meal
meal_chicken.source: Poore & Nemecek (2018) per-kg values via Our World in Data, times assumed portion sizes
meal_chicken.note: About 120 g of chicken plus sides.

meal_mutton.label: Mutton or lamb meal
meal_mutton.source: Poore & Nemecek (2018) per-kg values via Our World in Data, times assumed portion sizes
meal_mutton.note: About 100 g of lamb or mutton plus sides.

meal_beef.label: Beef or buffalo meal
meal_beef.source: Poore & Nemecek (2018) per-kg values via Our World in Data, times assumed portion sizes
meal_beef.note: About 100 g of beef or buffalo plus sides. Buffalo and dairy-herd beef can be lower than beef-herd beef.

waste_general.label: General household waste
waste_general.source: Mixed household waste sent to landfill is commonly quoted at roughly 0.4 to 0.6 kg CO2e per kg
waste_general.note: Mostly methane from food waste. Depends a lot on local disposal.
